channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Manchester Evening News accused of stoking anti-cycling sentiment after “incorrectly” claiming new bike lane set to be “ripped up again”
item.description: Local cycling campaigners have criticised the MEN’s reporting on the latest instalment of Oldham Road’s “insane saga”, pointing out that the cycle lane will remain in place – and is simply being painted green

item.title: “Very, very few people can break the speed limit on a bike”: James May slams Mr Loophole’s call for clampdown on ‘speeding’ cyclists, claiming problem is with illegal e-motorbikes and “nothing to do with cycling”
item.description: “30mph on the flat on a bicycle is Tour de France stuff… These campaigns always demonise ‘speeding cyclists’,” the former Top Gear host said

item.title: The cycling media may be struggling and shrinking… but that’s not an excuse to shill for murderous regimes and crap cycling routes
item.description: Cycling media companies need to earn money to survive, but at what cost? George Hill weighs in on a partnership that left him less than impressed

item.title: “Sacrificing safety for drivers’ benefit”: Plan to reopen ‘cycling only’ road to motorists using active travel funds branded a “disgrace” – as council dismisses protected bike lanes as “impractical, costly, and unviable”
item.description: A public consultation on the scheme was paused and then restarted this week after councillors called for clarification on the plans, which could see motorists allowed to drive on the road’s painted cycle lanes

item.title: Jeremy Vine shares footage of phone-using taxi driver fined £500, after former MP branded presenter “nasty” for reporting law-breaking motorists
item.description: Broadcaster releases footage of incident which saw the taxi driver receive six penalty points and a hefty fine, former MP Kate Hoey having claimed reporting law-breaking drivers is "a nasty thing to do" while telling Vine to "report cyclists rushing through red lights if he wants to play tell-tale"

item.title: Cleat-based CycloWatt power meter soars past crowdfunding goal within days, a host of new kit from Rapha + more
item.description: All the hottest new tech from the week that was, including stuff from Colnago, Hutchinson, Rapha, Giant and more

item.title: “There’s a reason I’m out riding alone”: Jonas Vingegaard questions if pro cyclists will soon need “personal bodyguards” to train in public
item.description: Two-time Tour de France winner was left bloodied by a training crash at the start of the year while he was being followed by a fan on a descent

item.title: BBB ArcticDuty Shoe Covers
item.description: Warm with good reflectives and easy to put on, though they are expensive

item.title: “An absolute nightmare”: Wrong turn disaster causes carnage at Strade Bianche
item.description: Disbelief as chase group including Demi Vollering, Lotte Kopecky and Pauline Ferrand-Prévot follow race motorbike off the course, all but ending hopes of victory

item.title: Outrage as pro cyclist appears to punch rival during race
item.description: Footage of incident emerged on social media after UCI 1.2 race in the Netherlands
